Linear interaction in tests runs against recorded Linear responses; no test and no build session calls a live Linear workspace\u0022,\u0022h9k connection add linear takes the API key the way h9k connection add jira takes its token: prompted by default and stored in the install\\u0027s own credentials directory (never inside a project, never replicated), or named with --token-env or, on macOS, --keychain; it probes Linear\\u0027s viewer query, refuses a rejected key with the remedy, and records the viewer\\u0027s id and name on the connection; the connection records only the credential reference\u0022,\u0022One Linear connection per install, refused on a second exactly as Jira\\u0027s is\u0022,\u0022h9k project set \\u003Cproject\\u003E --linear \\u003CTEAM\\u003E binds a default team for new issues after confirming with Linear that the team key exists, refusing an unknown key on the spot; \\u0027none\\u0027 clears it\u0022,\u0022A project has at most one tracker (none, GitHub issues, Jira, or Linear): binding Linear on a project with another tracker set is refused, naming the current one, and a task on a Linear project is refused a --from-jira or --from-issue link, naming the project\\u0027s tracker\u0022,\u0022Changing a project\\u0027s tracker later stays possible: existing task links keep their provider and remain readable and closable as history, and only new links must match the new tracker\u0022,\u0022h9k task add --from-linear \\u003Cidentifier or URL\\u003E and h9k task link-linear \\u003Ctask\\u003E \\u003Cidentifier\\u003E read the issue through Linear\\u0027s API, accept an issue from any team the key can see (no bound-team check), and record it as linear:\\u003Cidentifier\\u003E\u0022,\u0022Adoption maps Linear state types: backlog, unstarted, and started adopt; completed, canceled, and duplicate are refused; triage is refused with a pointer to h9k idea add --from-linear\u0022,\u0022When Linear answers not found for a linked issue, the refusal says the issue may have moved to another team (which gives it a new identifier) and names h9k task link-linear \\u003Ctask\\u003E \\u003Cnew identifier\\u003E as the relink\u0022,\u0022An HTTP 200 response carrying a GraphQL errors array is treated as a failure, and a 429 RATELIMITED response maps to an outage with its Retry-After\u0022,\u0022h9k doctor probes the Linear connection when a project\\u0027s tracker is Linear, distinguishing no connection from a rejected key\u0022,\u0022h9k task show renders a Linear link as the issue\\u0027s web URL\u0022]},\u0022AgentContext\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022BlockedBy\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022Type\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022Model\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022RevisedAt\u0022:\u00222026-10-29T15:28:40.830321\u002B00:00\u0022,\u0022RevisedByOwnerId\u0022:\u002201a00d41-5a50-7368-b048-72bcfee948bf\u0022,\u0022EpicId\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022QueuePriority\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022ReviewStageComposition\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022ReviewStageCompositionAcknowledged\u0022:false,\u0022ClearInteractiveMode\u0022:false,\u0022StackedOnTaskId\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022StackedOnPullRequestNumber\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022CloseLinkedIssue\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022SpikeKind\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022ExitCriterion\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022Constraints\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022Effort\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false}}","originEventId":"e31335b8-f2e8-4621-97ec-f131b309fb30","originSequence":140040,"originNodeId":"01a00d41-5b80-753d-a3f1-070b25e490e4","originOwnerRootFingerprint":"c8f5c85900dac9911ce1ada43484dc7bf91a2a3e86efa8812d9f84cfd25bf2ac","originAt":"2026-10-29T15:28:40.841084+00:00","originProjectId":"01a00d41-5d9a-73cc-b648-af431f721a71"},{"streamId":"01a18847-5de2-763c-84cb-e68b86b93537","eventTypeName":"Hall9k.Domain.Features.Tasks.Events.TaskAdded","eventDataJson":"{\u0022Id\u0022:\u002201a18847-5de2-763c-84cb-e68b86b93537\u0022,\u0022ProjectId\u0022:\u002201a00d41-5d9a-73cc-b648-af431f721a71\u0022,\u0022Objective\u0022:\u0022On a Windows node, a tracker credential (a Jira token today, a Linear API key once the Linear connector ships) can be stored in and read from Windows Credential Manager, as the Windows counterpart of the macOS --keychain reference\u0022,\u0022AcceptanceCriteria\u0022:[],\u0022Type\u0022:\u0022Feature\u0022,\u0022AgentContext\u0022:\u0022Gap: src/Hall9k.Connectors/Credentials/CredentialVault.cs reads keychain: references only through the macOS security tool and refuses them off macOS (line 225, at dacb26e61). On Windows a tracker credential can only be a file: reference in ~/.hall9k/credentials or an env: variable. Brian (2026-10-29, relayed by the Linear discovery session for idea 5d12221a) wants Credential Manager for every tracker, not only Linear. Interim ruling: Windows matches Jira\\u0027s current behavior until this ships (file or --token-env), and Linear draft e76868de\\u0027s criteria already say so, so nothing in the Linear chain waits on this. Credentials are node-local and never replicate; keep it that way. Open for the walk: reference syntax (reuse keychain: per platform or a separate scheme), the native binding (CredRead and CredWrite versus a helper tool), whether Linux gets a Secret Service counterpart or stays refused, and test shape without touching the real store on CI.\u0022,\u0022Constraints\u0022:null,\u0022ExternalReference\u0022:null,\u0022AddedAt\u0022:\u00222026-10-29T15:29:00.9031\u002B00:00\u0022,\u0022AddedByOwnerId\u0022:\u002201a00d41-5a50-7368-b048-72bcfee948bf\u0022,\u0022Model\u0022:\u0022\u0022,\u0022BlockedBy\u0022:[],\u0022StartsAsDraft\u0022:true,\u0022SourceIdeaId\u0022:null,\u0022EpicId\u0022:null,\u0022ReviewStageComposition\u0022:null,\u0022ReviewStageCompositionAcknowledged\u0022:false,\u0022StackedOnTaskId\u0022:null,\u0022PreApproved\u0022:false,\u0022Origin\u0022:null,\u0022PreApproval\u0022:\u0022Off\u0022,\u0022StackedOnPullRequestNumber\u0022:null,\u0022SecondaryExternalReference\u0022:null,\u0022SpikeKind\u0022:null,\u0022ExitCriterion\u0022:null,\u0022InitialScope\u0022:\u0022Fleet\u0022}","originEventId":"38f7e57e-ee71-4273-8b68-e2414d1e4d5b","originSequence":140047,"originNodeId":"01a00d41-5b80-753d-a3f1-070b25e490e4","originOwnerRootFingerprint":"c8f5c85900dac9911ce1ada43484dc7bf91a2a3e86efa8812d9f84cfd25bf2ac","originAt":"2026-10-29T15:29:00.942377+00:00","originProjectId":"01a00d41-5d9a-73cc-b648-af431f721a71"}]
